env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: Given one idea, it faithfully implements the code changes, runs the experiment in an isolated git worktree, and reports evidence.
env_context_strategy.note: Executor explores/edits the target repo with tools; no injected retrieval described. Single-valued dimension coded as agent_driven_navigation.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: abstracts the lesson upward so ancestor nodes and future ideas inherit it
context_compaction.note: Insight abstraction/backpropagation replaces raw traces; src/core includes 'context mgmt' per project structure.

observation_format.evidence_quote: an **eval script** — prints one `score:` line when run

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: `arbor mcp` | Run Arbor's keyless deterministic tools as an MCP server (needs the `[mcp]` extra).
protocol_standardization.note: MCP server is an optional extra; native CLI runtime does not require it.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Shared infrastructure: ReAct loop, tools, LLM providers, context mgmt
loop_primitives.note: Hypothesis tree with prune/merge = tree_search; edit-eval-keep loop = generate_test_repair; EventBus = event_driven; coordinator ideates then dispatches = plan_execute.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: a persistent tree that links hypotheses, artifacts, evidence, and distilled insights across time

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: selected hypotheses are sent to independent Executors, which implement them in fresh worktrees

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: | `review` | Pauses before each node and Executor. |
human_in_loop.note: Default in the sample config is `review`; modes auto|direction|review|collaborative are configurable. Intake also requires explicit contract confirmation.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The tree therefore acts as the operational research state of the system

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Each run leaves concrete, reusable findings — a dataset quirk that helped, a trap to avoid; the next similar task recalls them at intake
long_term_memory.note: Skills exist as markdown playbooks (src/skills/) but are static instructions, not cross-run learned memory.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: interrupt with `Ctrl+C` and continue later with `--resume`; Arbor reloads the Idea Tree and picks up where it left off

self_verification.evidence_quote: a change is kept only if it clears a margin on the **held-out test** split
self_verification.note: Harness runs the eval script and gates merges; coordinator reviews executor evidence; optional novelty/search verdicts use a separate LLM agent.

retry_policy.note: Repeated hypotheses are retried/refined until the merge threshold is cleared or the cycle budget is exhausted; closest value chosen.

rollback.evidence_quote: Each Executor works in its own worktree on a dedicated branch.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: `--max-turns N` | Hard cap on coordinator ReAct turns — a cost/runaway safety valve.
termination_condition.note: Also `--max-cycles`; coordinator can decide to stop (DECIDE step).

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Claude via the native Anthropic Messages API (signed thinking + prompt caching).
cost_controls.note: Budget/cycle caps via config; `/cost` prints token usage.

timeouts.evidence_quote: required outputs, and timeout presets all come from the plugin

execution_isolation.evidence_quote: Each Executor works in its own worktree on a dedicated branch.
execution_isolation.note: Isolation is git-worktree level on the local host; no container described.

filesystem_access.evidence_quote: `--cwd` is the default boundary; external paths must be named explicitly and are re-authorized after chat resume.
filesystem_access.note: Eval script and data files are protected from modification.

network_policy.evidence_quote: unless you set `search.builtin_backend: alphaxiv` (and, for pre-experiment checks, `auto_search_on_add: true`), Arbor never touches the network for literature.

permission_model.evidence_quote: | `review` | Pauses before each node and Executor. |
permission_model.note: Sample config default is review mode; `auto` mode is fully autonomous. Protected eval/data paths act as a static allowlist-style restriction.

tracing.evidence_quote: Each run writes a session directory with `REPORT.md`, `events.jsonl`, `run_stats.json`, the Idea Tree, and per-experiment artifacts

replayability.evidence_quote: `arbor replay <session>` | Replay any past run's `events.jsonl` from its timeline

eval_hooks.evidence_quote: Run Arbor on a benchmark | copy it out of the repo, `git init`, run `arbor` inside it
eval_hooks.note: The repo ships a benchmark zoo plus `arbor benchmark verify/list/scaffold`; evaluation of the target task is run by the harness.

guardrails.evidence_quote: an **eval script** — prints one `score:` line when run; it is protected, so Arbor cannot modify it.

target_domain.evidence_quote: A generalist autonomous research agent — runs experiments, researches, and iteratively optimizes, autonomously.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: Anthropic, OpenAI / Responses API, and OpenAI-compatible backends via LiteLLM (DeepSeek, Gemini, Qwen, vLLM, Ollama, …)
